name: @revealui/ts-strada
description: Strada TypeScript Compiler API (typescript@6.x) for AST tooling. Monorepo catalog stays on 6.x while Next.js requires classic typescript/lib/typescript.js; dual 6+7 splits peer type graphs (e.g. lexical). Import this package for createSourceFile/forEachChild; do not import typescript for Compiler API work.

scripts.test: node -e "const ts=require('@revealui/ts-strada'); if (typeof ts.createSourceFile!=='function') process.exit(1); console.log('strada', ts.version);"
